competing_hypotheses.statement: Large-wallet address growth, new XRPL addresses and positive cumulative ETF net inflows may indicate persistent longer-horizon demand.
evidence_for: Santiment metric relayed by BeInCrypto reached 2,147 addresses holding at least 1 million XRP.
Reported cumulative XRP ETF net inflows remained near USD 1.81 billion.
Kraken last price was above its reported 24-hour VWAP at capture.
evidence_against: October ETF net inflows slowed materially versus September.
November 2 showed an outflow and November 3 zero net flow.
Wallet counts do not prove beneficial-owner accumulation or net capital purchases.

competing_hypotheses.statement: Negative Coinbase premium and slower ETF inflows may indicate weaker marginal U.S. demand even while cumulative ETF inflows remain positive.
evidence_for: CryptoQuant reported Coinbase Premium near -0.16 percent.
BeInCrypto reported October ETF net inflows USD 18.83 million versus September USD 121.40 million.
BeInCrypto reported a November 2 outflow and zero net flow November 3.
24/7 Wall St reported XRP below its 50-day and 200-day averages as of November 2.
evidence_against: Cumulative ETF net inflows remain positive.
The November 4 price snapshot was near USD 1.30 and large-wallet address counts increased.

competing_hypotheses.statement: Coinbase and SBI distribution can expand RLUSD access, but RLUSD's multi-chain support and stablecoin settlement may not create proportional XRP demand.
evidence_for: Coinbase supports RLUSD on XRPL, Base and Ethereum.
Coinbase said Global Exchange collateral availability would follow, not that it was live at launch.
SBI VC Trade offers RLUSD in Japan; no XRP bridge volumes are disclosed.
evidence_against: RLUSD activity on XRPL may create some native XRP fee, liquidity or bridge demand where XRP is actually used.

competing_hypotheses.statement: The Binance incident may be largely exchange-specific if withdrawals normalize and other assets return to net inflows, limiting broader XRP spillover.
evidence_for: CryptoQuant reported ETH, USDT and USDC flows returned to net inflows by November 3.
No XRP-specific Binance withdrawal amount was established.
evidence_against: The incident produced large gross transfers, freezes and subsequent customer outflows across major assets.
Exchange confidence shocks can affect cross-venue liquidity and risk appetite.

competing_hypotheses.statement: The apparent difference between Kraken's nearly flat last-versus-open snapshot and crypto.news' +2.15 percent widget may be explained by different venues, baselines or capture times rather than a true contradiction.
evidence_for: Kraken API returned last USD 1.30325 and 24-hour open USD 1.30410.
crypto.news displayed USD 1.31 and +2.15 percent in its article widget.
evidence_against: No synchronized timestamped multi-venue capture was obtained to resolve the difference.

disconfirming_evidence: An address holding at least 1 million XRP is not a verified unique investor; exchange, custodian and omnibus wallets can distort address counts.
New XRPL addresses do not necessarily represent new people, active users, economic transfers or XRP demand.
Coinbase Premium is a relative Coinbase/Binance price measure, not a direct U.S. net capital-flow series.

ETF cumulative net inflows, daily net flows and mark-to-market net assets are different measurements. The USD 1.42B October 30 and USD 1.46B November 4 net-asset values are dated observations, not a contradiction to be averaged.
Coinbase's RLUSD launch supports XRPL, Base and Ethereum. Multi-chain RLUSD distribution does not automatically require XRP as a bridge asset.
Coinbase stated RLUSD collateral availability on Global Exchange would follow; it was not described as live at initial launch.
SBI VC Trade's RLUSD distribution does not establish XRP collateral, XRP purchases or XRP settlement volumes.
Kraken's narrow top-of-book spread does not establish executable depth at institutional order sizes or consolidated liquidity.
CryptoQuant's Binance incident transfers and later asset-specific net outflows are not XRP-specific. They must not be converted into an XRP flow feature.
The Kraken ticker and crypto.news price widget were not synchronized; do not average their price or 24-hour change.
No raw response bytes, SHA-256 receipts or independent timestamp anchors were captured for this web research.

data_quality.source_independence: SoSoValue is the common underlying ETF dataset in multiple secondary reports; Santiment is the underlying wallet metric; CryptoQuant supplies the Coinbase premium and Binance incident analysis; Coinbase, Ripple and Kraken are primary issuer/exchange sources for their own statements and ticker.
data_quality.timestamp_quality: Publication dates and displayed article times are preserved. Kraken retrieval time is recorded, but its returned ticker payload has no exchange event timestamp. No independent timestamp anchor was used.
data_quality.direct_etf_source_access: SoSoValue returned HTTP 403; ETF numbers remain secondary-source relays.
data_quality.order_book_depth: Not captured. Only Kraken top bid/ask was observed.
data_quality.derivatives: No synchronized XRP futures open-interest, funding or liquidation series captured in this update.
data_quality.exchange_flows: No XRP-specific exchange-flow series captured. Binance incident data is multi-asset and provider-reported.
data_quality.model_eligibility_reason: No byte-complete raw-source receipts, SHA-256 hashes or independent timestamp anchors; ETF data is relayed from one inaccessible underlying dashboard; no synchronized multi-venue depth, derivatives or XRP-specific exchange-flow series; no new out-of-sample evaluation.

predictions.reason: The evidence is mixed and not a complete point-in-time XRP feature set. No directional forecast is justified by this research snapshot.

Obtain direct timestamped XRP ETF daily-flow data from SoSoValue or an independent source; retain daily net flows, cumulative net flows and mark-to-market net assets as separate fields.
Obtain a timestamped CryptoQuant or exchange-native Coinbase Premium series and compare it with synchronized spot prices and volumes.
Track Santiment's 1M-plus XRP address metric as an address series, and test it against exchange/custodian clustering and independent on-chain balance cohorts.
Separate RLUSD supply and transfers by XRPL, Base and Ethereum; measure native XRP fee use, bridge volume, liquidity inventory and collateral separately.
Verify when Coinbase Global Exchange actually enables RLUSD collateral; until then classify the feature as announced future availability.
Reconcile CryptoQuant's Binance gross incident transfers, Binance's reported net customer withdrawals and later asset-specific net flows without attributing any amount to XRP absent direct evidence.
Feed the new market observations into the point-in-time feature pipeline only after raw bytes, hashes, source timestamps and source independence checks are captured.
Keep directional forecasts disabled until chronological walk-forward results beat all four baselines and calibration, drift and shadow-evaluation gates pass.
